requests.prompt: Summarize the benefits of dynamic batching in LLM serving in three bullet points.
Describe the architectural trade-offs between Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) and Inter-Token Latency (ITL) when serving multi-tenant LLM workloads with heterogeneous prompt lengths.
What is memory bandwidth saturation in modern GPU architectures?

Text: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by using a lightweight draft model to generate a sequence of candidate tokens in parallel, which are subsequently verified by the primary target model in a single forward pass. If the draft tokens match the target model distribution, multiple tokens are accepted in one step, significantly improving generation throughput without altering output quality. The acceptance rate depends heavily on the alignment between the draft and target models, the temperature of generation, and domain complexity. Task: Provide a concise two-sentence summary outlining the core mechanism and key performance factor of speculative decoding.
Provide a one-sentence definition of Time-To-First-Token (TTFT).
Why does high temperature increase output entropy during token sampling?

Solve this scheduling problem step-by-step: An inference server processes batches of up to 4 requests. Each batch takes exactly 40ms to execute. If requests arrive at a Poisson rate of 80 requests/sec, what is the minimum number of parallel worker slots required to maintain a stable queue where arrival rate does not exceed maximum service rate? Show your mathematical derivation.

Text: FlashAttention and FlashAttention-2 reformulate exact attention computation to optimize GPU SRAM and HBM memory transfers. By tiling the query, key, and value matrices and performing softmax reduction incrementally in fast on-chip shared memory, FlashAttention avoids materializing the quadratic intermediate attention matrix in high-bandwidth memory (HBM). This results in dramatic memory savings and substantial wall-clock speedups for long-sequence workloads. Task: Summarize how tiling and incremental softmax enable linear memory complexity in FlashAttention.
